The '''Miv'rah system''' was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Nestt-class light freighter|light freighter]] ''[[Miv'rah Firestorm]]''.<ref name="Wanted">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Miv'rah system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
